game_start.intro: Mchezo unanuka. Suti ya kupiga chapuo: {trump_suit} (chapuo cha kupiga chapuo: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
We ni Mchezaji {player_id} katika Whist ya Kijerumani.
{phase_info}
Una mikono {hand_size} ya kadi.
Cheza kadi kwa kutumia '[play N]', ambapo N ni nafasi yake kwenye mkono wako (kwa mfano '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: GĨCUNJIRI KŨRUTWO: ũrĩa ũhootanaga kĩgeranio o gĩothe nĩ we wĩyohagĩra kadi ĩrĩa ĩrorete igũrũ na ũcio ũkũhootwo agacoka akeyũkia karati ĩngĩ kuuma gĩkero-inĩ. Kĩgerania kĩrĩa kĩahotetwo ihinda rĩrĩ gĩtituaga kũrũa kana gũtoorania.
player_prompt.phase_playing: GĨCUNJĨ KŨREKIA: Mbarathi nĩ ĩrĩkĩtie kũhĩa. Kĩgeranio o gĩothe kuuma rĩu no kĩhote gũgũteithia ũhootane.

next_card.playing_phase: Gũtirĩ kaarĩ kahingũririo - mũbira wa gũcaria nĩ wambĩrĩirie.
next_card.deck_empty: Gĩcunjĩ kĩu gĩtirĩ kĩndũ - gũtirĩ kandi ĩheanĩtwo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Gũthaka gũtiagĩrĩire. Hũthĩra '[play N]' gũthaka karati ya Nth ĩrĩa ũrĩ nayo guoko-inĩ gwaku.
invalid_move.bad_position: Kaarĩ kau gatirĩ ho. Ũkoragwo na kaarĩ {hand_size}
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: No mũhaka wĩke o taguo na ũhũthagĩre kadi ya {lead_suit}.

trick.won_learning: Mchezaji {winner_id} anashinda mchezo huo kwa kutumia {card} na kuchukua kadi iliyo wazi.

phase.learning_complete: Gĩthaka kĩu gĩgĩkira, na mũico wa kwĩruta ũgĩkinya - o kĩgeranio kĩrĩa kĩngĩ nĩ kĩa bata harĩ kũhootana.

draw.loser_received: Ũrĩ o hĩndĩ ũrahĩirũo nĩ mũtego na ũkĩruta {card} kuuma gĩthũri-inĩ.

turn.scores_learning: Michezo iliyoshinda mpaka sasa - Mchezaji 0: {tricks0}, Mchezaji 1: {tricks1}

trick_view.empty: Gũtirĩ ihengere cia kũina irĩ na kĩene kĩu.
